multi_column.title: Multi-column layout / gutter detection
multi_column.summary: text lines merged across column boundaries, or column order inverted (right column read before left)
multi_column.note: assemble::assemble_reading_order's XY-cut now qualifies a vertical gutter against the page's own median character size (MIN_GUTTER_EMS), not just a fixed page-width fraction (MIN_CUT_FRACTION), so narrow (1 em) column gutters recover column-major order the same way wide ones already did

footnote.title: Footnotes
footnote.summary: footnote text merged into body `Text` region instead of classified as `Footnote`; footnote markers (superscript numerals) not linked to their note
footnote.note: classified via layout::classify_block's footnote rule (requires a block to sit low on the page, carry a smaller font than the rest of the page, and open with a recognized footnote marker) -- but serialize::render_block has no Footnote arm yet, so marker-to-note linking/rendering is still open

blocked.unblocked_by: Add a `RegionClass::Footnote` arm to `serialize::render_block`; link markers to their note

header_footer.title: Page headers/footers repeated across pages
header_footer.summary: header/footer text leaking into the body text stream; running headers misclassified as `Section-header`
header_footer.note: layout::band_of's shape test (thin strip, detached from the body by a minimum gap) plus a cross-page repeated_running_bands pass, suppressed in serialize::render_block

multi_line_table_cell.title: Nested/multi-line table cells
multi_line_table_cell.summary: cells spanning multiple visual lines merged incorrectly with adjacent rows; rowspan/colspan not detected

blocked.unblocked_by: Stage 4b vision detector — the documented `unimplemented!()` stub

multi_line_table_cell.pdf_backed_reason: Real Stage 1 block grouping merges the row's cells together across the column gap in a way a hand-authored already-split `Document` can't demonstrate.

merged_table_cell.title: Merged table cells (rowspan/colspan)
merged_table_cell.summary: TEDS-Struct penalizes tree-topology mismatches here most heavily

blocked.unblocked_by: Stage 4b vision detector — the documented `unimplemented!()` stub

borderless_table.title: Borderless / whitespace-delimited tables
borderless_table.summary: no ruling lines for the layout model to key off; frequently misclassified as plain `Text`

blocked.unblocked_by: Stage 4b vision detector — the documented `unimplemented!()` stub

nested_formula.title: Nested mathematical formulas
nested_formula.summary: inline formulas embedded mid-sentence not separated from surrounding text; multi-line/stacked formulas (fractions, summations, matrices) fragmented into multiple bounding boxes

blocked.unblocked_by: Stage 4b vision detector — the documented `unimplemented!()` stub

super_subscript.title: Superscript/subscript handling
super_subscript.summary: footnote markers, exponents, and chemical/math subscripts causing baseline-clustering errors in Stage 1's line grouping
super_subscript.note: extract::group_words's is_script_continuation check now recognizes a smaller, baseline-offset, nearby character as a super/subscript of its predecessor and attaches it to its base instead of splitting it off
super_subscript.pdf_backed_reason: A character-extraction/baseline-clustering failure in the real PDFium text layer; a synthetic already-grouped `Document` gives Stage 1's baseline clustering nothing to get wrong. **Fixed** — this is the one PDF-backed case that already passes the scoreboard.

rotated_text.title: Rotated or vertical text
rotated_text.summary: sidebar labels, rotated table headers, CJK vertical text (relevant given Traditional Chinese/Japanese document support)

blocked.unblocked_by: Read PDFium's rotation matrix / encoding table / z-order in `extract.rs`

rotated_text.pdf_backed_reason: Needs real glyph rotation data from PDFium's text layer.

figure_caption.title: Figure/caption association
figure_caption.summary: captions not correctly linked to their parent `Picture`/`Table` region, or associated with the wrong figure when multiple figures share a page
figure_caption.note: layout::is_caption covers the caption half, but no code path emits RegionClass::Picture

blocked.unblocked_by: Stage 4b vision detector — the documented `unimplemented!()` stub

list_nesting.title: List-item nesting
list_nesting.summary: multi-level bullet/numbered lists collapsed into flat `List-item` blocks, losing hierarchy
list_nesting.note: reading order now passes after the narrow-gutter fix shared with multi-column above -- each side-by-side outline is read fully before the next; hierarchy/depth itself is still not modeled, so nested lists still flatten into one flat sequence

cross_page_continuation.title: Cross-page table/paragraph continuation
cross_page_continuation.summary: tables or paragraphs split across a page boundary not stitched back together
cross_page_continuation.pdf_backed_reason: Needs a real multi-page extraction; `assemble_reading_order` only operates within a single page, and a synthetic multi-page `Document` wouldn't exercise the actual stitching gap PDFium extraction produces.

section_header_vs_bold.title: Section headers vs. bold body text
section_header_vs_bold.summary: `Section-header` misclassified as `Title` or emphasized `Text` when font-weight is the only visual cue

blocked.reason: Corpus schema carries no font-weight signal
blocked.unblocked_by: Extend `extract`/the corpus JSON schema with font name/weight *before* touching the classifier

embedded_font.title: Embedded/CID-keyed fonts and ligatures
embedded_font.summary: pdfium character extraction dropping or garbling glyphs from non-standard font encodings

blocked.unblocked_by: Read PDFium's rotation matrix / encoding table / z-order in `extract.rs`

embedded_font.pdf_backed_reason: Needs a real custom-encoded/CID-keyed font to reproduce dropped/garbled glyphs.

overlapping_text.title: Overlapping/z-ordered text objects
overlapping_text.summary: watermarks, stamps, or redaction boxes overlapping real text and corrupting bbox clustering

overlapping_text.pdf_backed_reason: Needs real z-ordered text objects from a PDF.
